chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: Duke Ellington's hiring habits
summary: Ellington brought only outstanding men into the band and never changed the sound without reason.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them

He wanted something from that top musician that he brought into the band. And when he brought him into that band, he was an outstanding man in that band.
